name: public-db-single-region
description: Client portfolio reporting app for UK wealth management clients. Python API on a single VM in London, PostgreSQL database with a public IP so the analytics team can connect directly. Nightly backups to Object Storage in the same region. This is a tier-1 system.

name: offshore-analytics-copy
description: Document store for client statements in an Object Storage bucket encrypted with Oracle-managed keys. A copy is replicated to a US region each night for the analytics team.

name: idle-gpu-batch
description: Nightly risk calculation batch job running on a large GPU shape that stays on 24/7, although the job only takes about an hour.
